name: vc3d-agent-session
label: Real data render
alt: A replay of a recorded agent session with Headless VC3D for agents: tool calls appear one by one on the left, each with its arguments, its real duration and values from its result (status finds the VC3D tools, selftest passes 8 of 8 checks, segment w035 is fetched, its normal points outward, the audit finds all 4,776 chunks, the surface is seated, a new trace does not pass its check, a 28-layer render and its maximum, a merge of two halves, the VC3D app with the scan open), and on the right the segment's z coordinate, CT layers under it and a screenshot of the VC3D app.
caption: Real data render: a replay of MCP tool calls an agent client made to Headless VC3D for agents on Hugging Face CPU Jobs, 24 Oct 2026, on PHerc0139 segment w035 at 9.362 um; values read from the session transcripts, waits skipped. CT and mesh geometry, no labels, no ink. Vesuvius Challenge open data, CC BY-NC 4.0.
